description: Resolve a UK place name or postcode to coordinates and the matching search page on UK Fitness Pro. Returns up to 5 candidates, best first, with the county or region where known. Use it when a place name is ambiguous (there are many Newports), then pass the chosen latitude/longitude to search_trainers.

query.description: UK town, city, area or postcode, e.g. "Newport", "Shoreditch", "BS1".

name: find_location
title: Find a location
